notes: Large assets NEVER live in git or in container images we build. They live under the asset root and are fetched on demand by scripts/assets/fetch.mjs.

CARLA is user-provided: users run their own CARLA container with maps baked inside (normal upstream distribution). We never package, rebuild, or redistribute CARLA or its map content. The docker-image entry below is a reference for the optional carla-up.sh developer convenience only.

file entries with "url": null are published through the SimForge platform blob store; digests below were measured from the canonical local copies on 2026-08-24. Populate url when a public location exists — fetch.mjs reports them honestly as unavailable until then.
